focus: Tracking Jensen Huang's Nvidia status, Anthropic's IPO pricing, and major funding rounds across AI infrastructure and robotics.

priorities.why: Jensen Huang addresses potential return as Nvidia CEO amid heightened geopolitical and congressional scrutiny.
Anthropic guides prospective IPO investors toward the high end of its $70-$78 range, with major stakes from Amazon and Google.
Genesis AI secures a massive $500M Series A at a $3.5B valuation for general-purpose robotics.
Science Corp raises $400M at a $3.5B valuation, highlighting massive investor appetite in brain-computer interfaces.
Jensen Huang's upcoming testimony before US House committees on December 1 carries major policy implications.
